title: Mahogany Hall Stomp and Louis's held note
summary: Dick brings up Mahogany Hall Stomp and the rhythm section with Pops Foster, Paul Barbarin and Luis Russell. Albert calls Armstrong's big tone a balloon tone. Dick then asks about changes in rhythm sections.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Don Albert made it 27, 1972. And I wanted to get into Mahogany Hall's Stomp and the way Louie holds a note on that, huh? Do you remember how Louie can hold a note? Right. You've got a good rhythm section there.
Yeah, well you've got Pops Foster and Paul Ballgren, Monty Johnson and Eddie Conda and Louie Russell.
Oh, they're just playing. That's all you know. Yeah. That's another one of these great big tones that we call a balloon tone.
Well, what about the changes in the rhythm section when you were growing up? Did you hear any changes?
